commit_message: ADR0133: fix mobile outer grid overflow
pr_title: ADR0133: complete Remote AI Studio first-release validation on current main
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR0133 Remote AI Studio first-release validation from current main while preserving ADR0155 managed-local AI changes. Adds deterministic host-owned Remote state, actual Microsoft Edge capture of the production loopback companion at desktop, narrow, and mobile widths, and fixes mobile intrinsic-width overflow by constraining the outer grid track as well as long metadata and form controls within the viewport.

## Validation

Requires full Windows Validation because `scripts/ci/**` changes, Automation Regression, and ChatGPT visual review of the production Remote AI Studio screenshots.
